subject: 351028 - excess not showing in the PO screen

candidates.text: Once a Purchase Order (PO) is created for an indent, these excess quantities are not visible on the RMPO screen → On Order tab.

The purpose of this enhancement is to make both Excess Material – PO and Excess Material – Stock data visible on the On-Order tab of the PO view, enabling users to adjust excess quantities directly during RMPO processing.
The system must allow users to view and adjust both Excess PO and Excess Stock quantities directly from the PO view.

Solution:
1. Enhance the RMPO screen – On Order tab to display:
2. Excess Material – PO
3. Excess Material – Stock
4. Excess PO quantities should be shown RMPO-wise for the same article/color/size.
5. Excess Stock quantities should reflect warehouse-received excess where indent open quantity is negative.
6. Ensure consistency with the existing Indent Stock Adjustment logic.
PO created quantity = 120 (due to MOQ or reduced requirement)
When a new indent is generated for the same article/color/size, the system should display this excess PO quantity RMPO-wise and allow adjustment up to 20 QTY.

Solution:
1. Indent required quantity = 100
2. PO created quantity = 120 (due to MOQ or reduced requirement)
3. Excess quantity = 20
4. When a new indent is generated for the same article/color/size, the system should display this excess PO quantity RMPO-wise and allow adjustment up to 20 QTY.
Material is received in the warehouse with excess quantity.

Solution:
1. Material is received in the warehouse with excess quantity.
2. Indent open quantity becomes negative (received quantity > required quantity).
3. This excess stock should be available for adjustment against other indents.
Excess Material – PO data must be visible in the On-Order tab of the PO view.
Excess Material – Stock data must be visible in the On-Order tab of the PO view.
System must allow adjustment of excess PO quantity up to the available excess amount.
Excess stock must be adjustable against other indents when indent open quantity is negative.
Data displayed in the PO view must match the values shown on the Indent Stock Adjustment screen.
Existing adjustment functionality must remain unaffected.

Acceptance Criteria:
1. Excess Material – PO data must be visible in the On-Order tab of the PO view.
2. Excess Material – Stock data must be visible in the On-Order tab of the PO view.
3. System must allow adjustment of excess PO quantity up to the available excess amount.
4. Excess stock must be adjustable against other indents when indent open quantity is negative.
5. Data displayed in the PO view must match the values shown on the Indent Stock Adjustment screen.
6. Existing adjustment functionality must remain unaffected.

chunks.title: Purpose
chunks.heading: … › Purpose
chunks.text:
Currently, Excess Material – PO and Excess Material – Stock data are visible only on the Indent Stock Adjustment screen. Once a Purchase Order (PO) is created for an indent, these excess quantities are not visible on the RMPO screen → On Order tab.
The purpose of this enhancement is to make both Excess Material – PO and Excess Material – Stock data visible on the On-Order tab of the PO view, enabling users to adjust excess quantities directly during RMPO processing.

chunks.title: Business Requirement
chunks.heading: … › Business Requirement
chunks.text:
The business requires full visibility of excess material quantities at the time of RMPO creation and adjustment. Currently, users can view and adjust excess quantities on the Indent Stock Adjustment screen, but once the PO is created, this information is no longer available in the RMPO “On Order” tab.
This limitation creates gaps in material planning and adjustment, especially when new indents are generated for the same article/color/size. The system must allow users to view and adjust both Excess PO and Excess Stock quantities directly from the PO view.

chunks.title: Solution
chunks.heading: … › Solution
chunks.text:
• Enhance the RMPO screen – On Order tab to display:
• Excess Material – PO
• Excess Material – Stock
• Excess PO quantities should be shown RMPO-wise for the same article/color/size.
• Excess Stock quantities should reflect warehouse-received excess where indent open quantity is negative.
• Ensure consistency with the existing Indent Stock Adjustment logic.
Excess PO Scenario:
• Indent required quantity = 100
• PO created quantity = 120 (due to MOQ or reduced requirement)
• Excess quantity = 20
• When a new indent is generated for the same article/color/size, the system should display this excess PO quantity RMPO-wise and allow adjustment up to 20 QTY.
Excess Stock Scenario:
• Material is received in the warehouse with excess quantity.
• Indent open quantity becomes negative (received quantity > required quantity).
• This excess stock should be available for adjustment against other indents.

• Excess Material – Stock data must be visible in the On-Order tab of the PO view.
• System must allow adjustment of excess PO quantity up to the available excess amount.
• Excess stock must be adjustable against other indents when indent open quantity is negative.
• Data displayed in the PO view must match the values shown on the Indent Stock Adjustment screen.
• Existing adjustment functionality must remain unaffected.
